Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring disclosures for single burial use of multiple interment space.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to single burial use of multiple interment space;adding a new section to chapter 68.04 RCW; and adding a new section tochapter 68.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 68.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: "Multiple interment" means two or more human remains are buried inthe ground, in outer burial enclosures or chambers, placed one on topof another, with a ground level surface the same size as a single graveor right of interment.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 68.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Every cemetery shall disclose and give to the person makingcemetery arrangements a written statement, contract, or other documentthat indicates all the items of property, merchandise, and service thatthe customer is purchasing, and the price of those items. (2) Any cemetery offering single burial use of multiple interment p. 1 SSB 5182space must disclose on the interment statement, contract, or otherdocument, the definition of multiple interment.
